entries.name: Utility Gas & Power / LE Energy
entries.service_area_detail: LE Energy (EIA-861 2024: ~15,400 Ohio residential electric customers) is the parent of Utility Gas & Power (Ohio/Illinois gas and electric supply: Columbia Gas of Ohio, Dominion East Ohio, Duke, AEP, AES, FirstEnergy) and Michigan Natural Gas LLC
entries.payment_processor: Utility consolidated billing (pay the local utility)
entries.notes: Your utility keeps delivering, handling emergencies and sending the monthly bill (with the UGP rate) - pay the utility, and you can stay on the utility's budget billing. Call Utility Gas & Power only about the rate. Fixed 12-month plans; cancelling early can carry an early termination fee, payable online at utilitygasandpower.com/early-termination-payment. The utility may charge $10 for more than one switch in 12 months. Toll-free 855-747-4931; local 614-706-3733 (Mon-Fri 8-5; info@utilitygasandpower.com). Mailing address 2680 Corporate Park Dr, Ste 100, Opelika, AL 36801. Outside Texas the supplier is usually billed through the local utility (utility consolidated billing): the supply charge is a line on the utility bill, so view, pay, set up or stop autopay, see history and get help (LIHEAP, budget billing, senior/low-income discounts, PIPP/PCAP) through the utility. Call the supplier about the rate, contract, renewal or cancellation; returning to the utility's default service takes 1-2 billing cycles, and fixed-rate contracts may carry an early termination fee (see the contract summary).
